study_type: Historical remedial extension after inspecting the original results; exploratory, never prospective
preserve_reference: The sealed 51-month A/B execution remains the reference, not overwritten
features: Identical return8 + market5 + macro momentum2 + ages2 for both definitions and all learned models
monthly_training_weight: Each target observation month sums to one; no rescaling of total weight
persistence: 99% mass on last causally observed state + 1% training prior; no tuning
jump_selection: Average logistic and regularized-XGB net 0/1 validation Sharpe over preceding three years; same selected JM labels for all models; ties choose lower penalty
conditional_mean: Actual BIL excess; monthly weighted; 12-month shrink toward the known overall mean; only available return/label pairs
holding_horizon_note: 21-day mean/variance planning horizon amortizes the objective's one-time transaction penalty only; actual fees remain 5 bp on every traded ETF leg. No claim of 21-day forecast accuracy or guaranteed cost reduction.
band_note: At signal close compare proposed and existing weights across nine legs. Below band, submit a HOLD-UNITS order with zero trade and fee, including overnight drift; never rebalance to old closing weights. Rebalance if the signal-close asset cap is breached. Log order weights separately from executed weights.
power: Conditional path-block power and 80% detectable effect; includes a variance uncertainty band but not full refitting/design-selection uncertainty

bridge.note: Full 2 x 4 x 3 factorial; no winning chain selection. Hard/soft use the same conditional means and the same bearish floor, isolating probability mixing. Paper/shrink combines return reference, weighting and shrinkage, explicitly a bundled effect. Actual fee always 5 bp.

reporting: Report every frozen variant and the full 141-month primary result, the common 51-month overlap, pre/post-2024 segments, and all baselines; no winning appendix promotion
success: Audited data, complete frozen execution, independent refits/replays, honest inference and diagnosis. Positive returns, ML superiority or significance are not guaranteed.
baselines: JM persistence and training-frequency forecasts use the same conditional means and allocation; unconditional MV uses the same monthly-weighted known five-year BIL excess mean, covariance and execution policy. Additional EW, SPY/IEF 60/40, 200-day trend and BIL benchmarks.
